project_type: Python Telegram inline bot using aiogram 3.x with Mistral LLM via OpenAI SDK
build_system: pip with requirements.txt, no Makefile or build script
test_framework: No test framework present in the repo
test_command: python -c "import main; import config; import handlers; import services"
verification_instructions: Install dependencies and verify imports succeed without errors. Since there are no tests, validate with Python syntax/import checks.
setup_instructions: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
environment_constraints: No test suite exists. Validation is limited to syntax checks and import validation. Bot requires TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and MISTRAL_API_KEY env vars to fully instantiate Settings.
key_patterns: Dataclass-based Settings in config/settings.py instantiated at module level. Single Router in handlers/inline.py. LLMService in services/llm.py. All handlers use aiogram 3.x patterns with async handlers and Router.
directory_structure: config/ - settings and config error classes; handlers/ - inline query handler router; services/ - LLM service wrapper; main.py - entry point
